title: puppi3 · Overview
description: At-a-glance: is the site up, traffic, members, engagement

target.rawSql:
SELECT published_at AS time, CONCAT('Published: ', title, '
This post up close ›') AS text, 'ghost' AS tags FROM posts WHERE type = 'post' AND status = 'published' AND $__timeFilter(published_at)

SELECT p."publishDate" AS time, initcap(replace(replace(i."providerIdentifier", '-standalone', ''), '-', ' ')) || ': ' || left(regexp_replace(p.content, '<[^>]+>', '', 'g'), 100) || CASE WHEN i."providerIdentifier" IN ('instagram', 'instagram-standalone', 'youtube', 'bluesky', 'threads', 'tiktok', 'tiktok-business') THEN '
This post up close ›' ELSE '' END AS text, 'social,' || i."providerIdentifier" AS tags FROM "Post" p JOIN "Integration" i ON i.id = p."integrationId" WHERE p."deletedAt" IS NULL AND p."parentPostId" IS NULL AND p.state = 'PUBLISHED' AND $__timeFilter(p."publishDate")

panels.title: Alerts firing now
panels.description: The website's alert rules (label project=puppi3, folder @SITE_NAME@) that are firing, pending or failing. Each also goes to ntfy, topic @NTFY_TOPIC@. Rules: stacks/monitoring/grafana/alerts.yml.

panels.title: Ghost backend
panels.description: Ghost admin API answering (not just a Cloudflare cache hit)

panels.title: Uptime 30d
panels.description: Share of the last 30 days the public site check (https://@SITE_HOST@ through Cloudflare, every 15 s) succeeded.

panels.title: Unique visitors
panels.description: Ghost counts a visitor as unique for one day: it uses no cookies, so it can't recognise someone the next day. This adds up each day's unique visitors over the selected range, the same number Ghost Admin shows as Unique visitors, so someone who visits on 3 days counts 3 times. For a range within one day Ghost reports hours instead, so a visitor who comes back hours later counts again.

panels.title: Pageviews
panels.description: Pages viewed in the selected range (Ghost's web analytics).

panels.title: Total members
panels.description: Everyone signed up to the site (free and paid), now.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS members FROM members

panels.title: New members (selected range)
panels.description: Signups in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_members FROM members WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS newsletters FROM emails WHERE status = 'submitted'

panels.title: Avg newsletter open rate
panels.description: Opens / delivered, across newsletters sent with open tracking on.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(opened_count) / NULLIF(SUM(delivered_count), 0), 1) AS open_rate FROM emails WHERE status = 'submitted' AND track_opens = 1

panels.title: Comments (selected range)
panels.description: Published comments made in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS comments FROM comments WHERE status = 'published' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Signups from posts (selected range)
panels.description: Members whose signup Ghost attributed to a post

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS signups FROM members_created_events WHERE attribution_type = 'post' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Unique visitors & pageviews
panels.description: Daily totals (@TZ_NAME@ time). Pick a range of a few days or more; each bar is one day. Unique visitors are counted per day: Ghost can't recognise someone on a later day (no cookies). Dotted lines mark what you posted: pink = a Ghost post, violet = a social post (Postiz). Hover the triangle at the bottom of a line to see which; switch them off at the top of the dashboard.

panels.title: Members over time
panels.description: Dotted lines mark what you posted: pink = a Ghost post, violet = a social post (Postiz). Hover the triangle at the bottom of a line to see which; switch them off at the top of the dashboard.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, members FROM (
  SELECT CAST(d AS DATETIME) AS time, SUM(n) OVER (ORDER BY d) AS members
  FROM (SELECT DATE(created_at) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM members GROUP BY d) daily
) t
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Posts doing well (last 30 days)
panels.description: Posts from the last 30 days on every network the bridge collects (and the site's own), judged against your other posts on the same network: Doing well = Doing great or Above usual. Above industry = above the published average for their network (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, newsletters only). Judged = the ones with enough earlier posts to compare with (5) and over 12 hours old. The analytics guide explains how. Not affected by the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Best posts lately
panels.description: The last 30 days' posts that did best against your usual post on their own network (on what that network ranks posts by, mostly per person reached). Hover vs your usual for why; vs industry compares each with the published average for its network. Click a row for that post up close (the Post dashboard). Not affected by the dashboard's time range.

links.title: This post up close: its numbers per day and what it did for the site

properties.value: Against the published average for this network (Instagram per person reached, TikTok and YouTube per view, newsletters' click rate). Mostly big brand accounts, so a second opinion. Hover for the numbers.

panels.title: Puppies petted (all time)
panels.description: Every pet of a puppy on the site (the theme sends them in batches to the Postiz bridge, which keeps the total in pets.json). Not affected by the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Puppies petted per day
panels.description: Pets per UTC day, from Prometheus scraping the bridge's counter every minute (kept for a year). Starts when the scrape job was added; days before that are empty.
